findings.message: Child-safe hard speed cap implemented via _speed vector clamped to MAX_SPEED (20.0). Fixes prior InputEvent misuse preventing unbounded acceleration.
findings.resolution: Speed clamping verified; players cannot exceed safe velocity limits.

findings.message: Safe egress with raycast fallback to last grounded position. On vehicle exit, raycast down from player finds ground or falls back to last known grounded position, preventing endless fall.
findings.resolution: Players cannot fall through world on vehicle egress; fallback mechanism confirmed.

findings.message: Collision layer/mask restoration on enter/exit ensures vehicle retains proper collision group membership.
findings.resolution: Vehicle collision layers properly maintained throughout lifecycle.

findings.message: Regression test _assert_vehicle_safety_and_fallbacks covers: speed cap, ramp grounded collision, void-safe egress, collision restore, fist fallback, equipped-tool fallback. All assertions pass.
findings.resolution: Comprehensive vehicle safety regression coverage verified.

findings.message: _spawn_npcs no longer early-returns on empty roster. Starter camp residents always spawn regardless of roster state.
findings.resolution: Camp civilians spawn reliably; empty roster edge case handled.

findings.message: NPC collision shapes are named for testability. Each NPC has named CollisionShape3D child node.
findings.resolution: Named collision shapes enable automated verification; testability confirmed.

findings.message: Camp civilian regression test validates: residents spawn with empty roster, grounded StaticBody3D, CapsuleShape3D collision, GreetTrigger Area3D, wander metadata, greeting/safe fart-reaction lines, wander loop stays grounded, dialogue label show/hide.
findings.resolution: Comprehensive camp civilian behavior coverage; all assertions pass.

findings.message: _tick_adventure_music implements correct state machine: drive (active vehicle) > danger (enemy within 15m) > explore (default). State transitions are deterministic and prioritized correctly.
findings.resolution: Music state machine verified; priority order correct per acceptance criteria.

findings.message: set_adventure_music_state supports explore, danger, drive, night states with curated Gen-Z phonk tracks. Two AudioStreamPlayers enable seamless crossfades.
findings.resolution: Music system supports all required states; crossfade infrastructure confirmed.

findings.message: rotate_adventure_track cycles through state-specific beds via seamless crossfade. Maintains continuous playback for long sandbox sessions.
findings.resolution: Track rotation verified; no music interruptions in sustained play.

findings.message: Runtime contract test verifies all state transitions: explore default, danger on enemy proximity (<15m), danger fallback on distance, danger fallback on defeat, drive priority over danger, drive return to explore on exit, state stability. All 10 assertions pass.
findings.resolution: Music state transition contract fully validated; test coverage complete.

findings.message: All vehicle runtime assertions pass in headless mode.
All camp civilian assertions pass in headless mode.
All music state-transition assertions pass in headless mode.
No regression in domain sandbox state tests.
No regression in application sandbox persistence tests.

summary: VS-048 implementation fully meets all acceptance criteria. Vehicle safety (speed cap, safe egress, collision restoration), camp civilians (reliable spawning, grounded characters, interaction/reaction lines), and music crossfade (continuous ambient bed with state-based transitions) are all production-ready. All regression tests pass. APPROVE for merge.
